selection: Lowest validation log loss, no test-year outcomes loaded

aptitude: Past classified-finisher pairwise performance minus pre-race Elo expected performance; shrunk toward zero for same venue, nearby distance and explicit AUTOSTART only. All same-day outcomes excluded.
test_policy: March and April 2026 already observed. No reuse for selecting V4; freeze another unseen period if validation improves.
